en.html:
Chachamaru Ashikaga had said she would give me a chance to kill Hikaru.

...Matlab what, exactly?

The Kubo of Horigoe did seem to have some abnormal power. Tens of thousands of soldiers also, naturally, to move wherever she wished.

Put the whole lot against Silver Star, and still she would not kill her.
That was my understanding.

Then why—

My heart was hammering away.
Bad foreboding raised bumps all over my skin.

Chachamaru Ashikaga was not lying.
This certainty itself was frightening me.

If her words were true, the thing I had wanted to take would be there for the taking.

Hikaru's life.

The moment I had been waiting for was coming near.

............That was the trouble. That was why I was afraid.

足利茶々丸は、光を殺す機会を与えると言った。

　……どういう事なのか。

　堀越公方に何らかの異能があるのはどうやら事実だ。
　そして無論、数万の兵力を意のままに動かす権力も
所有している。

　だがそのすべてを駆使して銀星号に挑もうと、討ち
果たす事は叶うまい。
　そう思う。

　なのに、

　……心臓が激しい動悸を訴える。

　不吉な予感に肌がぷつぷつ粟立つ。

　<ruby>足利茶々丸は嘘を言っていない<rt>・・・・・・・・・・・・・・</rt></ruby>。
　その確信に、俺は恐怖する。

　彼女の言葉が嘘でないなら、俺は望み通り奪えると
いう事なのだ。

　光の命を。

　待ち望んだ瞬間が近い。

　…………だから恐れている。

Nahin. Even if she was still sleeping, same problem. By such a simple method, a person like her could not possibly be killed.

So we should stop this.
Better to stop, no...

en.html:
Chachamaru Ashikaga slid open the door.

Inside, darkness.
Like the sea at night, nothingness spread without end.

Then slowly my eyes adjusted, and the room turned out to be almost the same as the one they had given me. Not much furniture. Fine tatami over the whole floor.

—Something white in the middle.

This feeling again. Of having seen it before.

　夜の海のように、茫漠と無が広がっている。

がわれた部屋と<ruby>殆<rt>ほとん</rt></ruby>ど変わりない一室だと知れた。
　そう多くない調度品。上質の畳が敷き詰められた床。

　既視感。
